title: Eggless Homemade Orecchiette with Leek and Pea Cream Sauce
summary: Make egg-free orecchiette pasta from scratch using equal parts semolina and all-purpose flour, then toss it in a light, flavorful leek, pea, and parmesan cream sauce.

steps.title: Combine the flours
steps.say: Combine equal parts of all-purpose flour and semolina pasta flour, about two cups of each, in a large bowl with a fork.
steps.look_for: A glass bowl containing both flours being mixed together with a fork.
steps.visual_note: The mixing bowl is placed on a brown baking mat with measuring containers nearby.

steps.title: Add water and form dough
steps.say: Make a well in the center of the flour. Pour in about three-quarters of a cup of cold water, then gradually mix and add more water until a dough forms.
steps.look_for: A shaggy, rough dough coming together in the glass bowl as water is incorporated by hand.
steps.visual_note: Flour clings to the cook's fingers as the dough forms into clumps.

steps.title: Knead the dough
steps.say: Turn the dough out onto a work mat and knead for about five minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
steps.look_for: A cohesive dough ball being pressed and kneaded on the silicone mat.

steps.title: Rest the dough
steps.say: Wrap the dough tightly in plastic wrap and let it rest on the counter for about half an hour.
steps.look_for: The smooth dough ball wrapped securely in clear plastic wrap on the work surface.

steps.title: Portion the dough
steps.say: Unwrap the rested dough, dust your board with flour, and cut the dough into four equal pieces using a bench scraper or knife.
steps.look_for: The dough ball being halved on a floured mat using a chef's knife.
steps.visual_note: Loose flour is scattered across the mat to prevent sticking.

steps.title: Roll into logs
steps.say: Take one piece of dough and roll, squeeze, and stretch it out into a half-inch thick log.
steps.look_for: The dough stretched and rolled into a long, uniform rope across the mat.

steps.title: Shape the orecchiette
steps.say: Cut the log into small pieces, roll each into a ball, and press your thumb in while dragging back to form orecchiette. Dust with flour on a tray.
steps.look_for: A baking sheet filled with shaped, flour-dusted orecchiette pasta shells.
steps.visual_note: The orecchiette shells have distinct thumb indentations in their centers.

steps.title: Clean the leeks
steps.say: Slice the leeks, place them into a bowl of water, and gently separate the layers. Let sit for a few minutes so any dirt sinks to the bottom.
steps.look_for: Chopped leek pieces submerged in a large glass bowl filled with water.
steps.visual_note: Cut leek rounds float on top of the clear water.

steps.title: Prepare aromatics and lemon
steps.say: Grate three garlic cloves using a microplane into paste. Strip and roughly chop about one teaspoon of fresh thyme, then juice one lemon into a bowl.
steps.look_for: A yellow manual citrus press squeezing a halved lemon into a glass bowl.
steps.visual_note: The grated garlic and chopped thyme are set aside on the wooden cutting board.

steps.title: Sauté the leeks
steps.say: Melt butter and olive oil in a skillet, lift out the sliced leeks, add them to the pan, and sauté for a few minutes until softened.
steps.look_for: Sliced leeks cooking and being stirred with a wooden spoon in a dark skillet.

steps.title: Simmer sauce with stock and peas
steps.say: Stir in the garlic and thyme, season with salt and pepper, then pour in the lemon juice and chicken stock. Simmer, then stir in frozen peas.
steps.look_for: Simmering liquid and leeks bubbling together in the skillet.

steps.title: Boil the pasta
steps.say: Gently separate the orecchiette and drop them into a pot of boiling water. Stir and cook for seven to eight minutes until they float to the top.
steps.look_for: Hands dropping fresh orecchiette pieces from a baking sheet into boiling water in a stockpot.

steps.title: Finish sauce and combine
steps.say: Stir a splash of cream and Parmesan cheese into the sauce just to warm through. Drain the cooked pasta, return it to the pot, and stir in the sauce to serve.
steps.look_for: The warm skillet sauce being poured directly over the drained pasta in the stockpot.
steps.visual_note: Steam rises from the pot as the sauce coats the pasta.
